hypothesis: Postupno prilagodavanje valutnih izlozenosti nakon promjena relativne monetarne politike moze uzrokovati visemjesecnu postojanost tecaja. Korporativni hedgeri i obvezni konverteri ne maksimiziraju kratkorocni prinos; ovo je pretpostavka, ne dokaz prednosti.
signal: At completed t close: close < SMA200 and SMA50 < SMA200. Enter next bar open, EUR cash sold for USD. Exit next open if not condition or held bars >=60.
stop: EURUSD upper stop entry midpoint +2*ATR20(t); USD exposure loses EUR value when EURUSD rises. Fixed, active entry day, gap exit max(open,stop), adverse spread/slippage; no same-day reentry.
sizing: Whole EUR units, exact EUR loss converting USD at stop ask plus entry and exit commissions <=0.5% equity, <=95% cash. No negative cash, no leverage.

costs.interest_note: Cash interest excluded; no borrowing. Report as limitation and opportunity cost, not actual broker total return.

research_boundaries: Midpoint fills and stop simulation are scenarios, not proven executable fills
